newsitem.title: UK: Royal Sun ends relationship with Chubb.
newsitem.headline: Royal Sun ends relationship with Chubb.

text.p: Royal SunAlliance, the UK composite insurer formed by a merger of Royal Insurance and Sun Alliance in July, said on Thursday it is to end a reciprocal reinsurance agreement with U.S.-based Chubb Corp.
Over the last few years, Sun Alliance had been reducing the amount of business it ceded to and received from Chubb.

About twelve months ago, the amounts mutually ceded were reduced by around one third. The merger with Royal this year means the new group has a substantial presence in the U.S. market through Royal's U.S. subsidiary, which had premium income of 1.05 billion stg in 1995.
"In the circumstances, both parties agreed that as a result of the merger the arrangement should be terminated," said Royal SunAlliance in a statement.

It added the impact on profits was not expected to be material. Premiums received by Royal SunAlliance this year under the arrangement are expected to be around 210 million stg and premiums ceded to Chubb about 120 million stg.
Royal SunAlliance said it plans to retain its five percent shareholding in Chubb.
